final: WITH c AS (SELECT staff_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM rental GROUP BY staff_id), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM c WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), r AS (SELECT c.staff_id, c.cnt, c.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share FROM c CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL AND c.cnt IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM r WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT r.staff_id, r.cnt, r.share FROM r CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND r.cnt > a.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(k.cnt), AVG(k.share), AVG(k.cnt - a.avg_cnt) FROM k CROSS JOIN a
